# Pf032 — Reader hangs during XCAF tree build on deep assembly

## Description

An XCAF document is built from a large STEP file with a deep assembly tree. The XCAF builder iterates assembly nodes recursively; for an N-level tree with M instances per level, it visits every instance N times — exponential. Apparent hang on files with deep assemblies.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file with 8-level deep assembly, 10 instances per level (10⁸ visits). Build XCAF tree.

## Expected kernel behavior

XCAF tree build memoises visited nodes; visit count linear in distinct nodes, not in instance paths.
